Container.Name: EdgeFetch-Agent
Container.Overview: Outbound-only Go HTTP/2 + SSRF-proxied Headless Chromium + Poppler PDF worker node for EdgeFetch (zero inbound router ports).

Config.Name: Hub URL
Config.Description: Cloudflare or self-hosted EdgeFetch Hub URL (e.g. https://edgefetch.example.com)

Config.Name: Agent Token
Config.Description: Shared or site-scoped agent secret (at least 24 characters)

Config.Name: Site ID
Config.Description: Unique lowercase identifier for this Unraid node
